scenes.title: The Ride That Stayed With Her
scenes.location: Gulmohar Heights · Tower C lift → Kapoor flat

blocks.text: Lift ka darwaaza band hua.
Meenakshi ne mirror mein khud ko dekha. Plum kurta, cream palazzo, khule baal aur haath mein cardigan.

blocks.alt: Meenakshi pausing before the elevator mirror in a plum embroidered outfit
blocks.caption: Scene 01 · Lift mirror — cinematic illustration; hairstyle and styling are interpretive.

blocks.text: Uske chehre par ek muskurahat aa gayi.
*Uff... kya ride thi!*
Uday aur Utkarsh ke beech woh paanch minute abhi bhi uske dimaag mein ghoom rahe the. Unki unexpected closeness, har speedbreaker par khud ko sambhalna, aur sabse badhkar apni reaction.
*"Aur mujhe woh sab achha bhi laga..."*
Yeh sochkar woh khud hi hans padi.
Phir Babloo ka compliment yaad aaya.
*"Babloo bhi aaj bade confidence mein tha!"*
**Ding!**
Lift khuli.
Flat mein enter karte hi Ishita ki awaaz aayi.

blocks.alt: Meenakshi arriving at the Kapoor flat while Ishita greets her from inside
blocks.caption: Scene 01 · Back at the flat — cinematic illustration.

blocks.text: **Ishita:** "Diii! Itni late? Aur car kahan hai?"
**Meenakshi:** "Ishu, ek glass paani pila de. Car ki kahaani baad mein!"
Woh handbag rakhkar bedroom ki taraf badhi.
**Ishita:** "Arre! Kahan ja rahi ho?"
**Meenakshi:** "Garam shower lene. Aaj bahut lamba din tha!"
Bedroom mein pahunchkar uski nazar dressing-table ke drawer par padi.
Nikhil ke liye subah taiyaar kiya surprise abhi wahin tha.
Meenakshi muskuraayi.
*"Aur aaj ka din abhi khatam bhi kahan hua hai..."*
